## Last-checked: 2026-11-23

# ellmos-ai/project-docs-template

Agent-ready project documentation template with START/STATE/TODO/DONE,
workflows, lightweight tooling, and LLM-friendly project memory.

Canonical repository:
https://github.com/ellmos-ai/project-docs-template

Primary audience:
- Maintainers who want predictable LLM-agent handoff files in a repo root.
- Claude Code, Antigravity/Gemini, Codex, and other AI coding-agent users.
- Teams that need lightweight project state, decision, task, and workflow docs.
- Template authors looking for a small alternative to heavy agent OS scaffolds.

Important files:
- `README.md`: human-facing overview, 18-point navigation, target personas, and project capabilities with implementation limits.
- `README_de.md`: complete German documentation, 18-Punkte-Schnellnavigation, and user guide.
- `README_es.md`, `README_fr.md`, `README_ru.md`, `README_ja.md`, `README_zh.md`, `README_hi.md`, `README_ar.md`, `README_bn.md`, `README_pt.md`: multilingual documentation guides.
- `SKILL.md`: product-specific LLM workflow skill for scaffolding, linting, archiving, and upgrading documentation profiles.
- `llm.txt`: compatibility pointer to `llms.txt` and `SKILL.md`.
- `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`: bilingual Contributor Covenant v2.1 community guidelines.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: bilingual development and invariant compliance guidelines (INV-LOCAL-01..INV-SLA-10).
- `NOTICE`: legal copyright attribution and ecosystem notice.
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`: Level 1 Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) and Governance Invariants Cross-Reference Matrix.
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt`: Level 1 SBOM plain-text companion with Invariant cross-reference matrix.
- `assets/terminal-workflow.svg`: dark-mode CLI workflow illustration (`init-project`, `doc-lint`, `todo-archive`, `--upgrade`).
- `template/TEMPLATE.md`: rationale, profile definitions, and file-by-file explanation.
- `template/_tools/init-project`: profile-based scaffold generator (`MINIMAL`, `STANDARD`, `FULL`).
- `template/_tools/init-project --upgrade`: one-step, manifest/hash-verified profile upgrade for existing generated projects; changed or unowned files fail closed rather than being merged.
- `tests/test_tools.py`: cross-profile and tool-integrity regression contract.
- `tests/test_metadata.py`: automated metadata, schema, and manifest parity test suite.
- `RELEASE_GATE.md`: commands and evidence required before release.
- `SECURITY.md`: bilingual vulnerability-reporting policy: best-effort support for 0.1.x, no guaranteed response time, and private reporting contacts.
- `template/START.md`: session bootstrap pattern.
- `template/STATE.md`: current-state snapshot pattern with waterline/split rule.
- `template/TODO.md` and `template/DONE.md`: active and completed task surfaces (with `TODO-SUBLIST.md` domain-splitting pattern).
- `template/MASTER-REGISTRY.md` and `template/REG-TEMPLATE.md`: central register index and sub-register blueprint.
- `template/HEADER-RULES.md`, `template/CUT-AND-CLUE.md`, and `template/MOVED-STUB.md`: 2-level self-healing headers, relative file splitting, and move pointers.
- `template/DECISIONS.md` and `template/PATTERNS.md`: decision, append-only `NACHTRAG`, and practice logs.

## Prerequisites

- Python 3.10 or newer (pure Python standard library at runtime; `dependencies = []`).
- Git (optional, for cloning and `--git` project initialization).

## Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ellmos-ai/project-docs-template.git
cd project-docs-template
python -m venv .venv
```

## Verification

- `python -m pytest -ra -v` (80 passed, 26 subtests passed) on Linux, Windows and macOS
- `python template/_tools/doc-lint --root template` (clean)
- `ruff check .` (100% clean)
- `python -m compileall -q tests template` (100% clean)

## Minimal Example

```bash
python template/_tools/init-project --target /path/to/my-project --name "my-project" --profile STANDARD --dry-run
python template/_tools/init-project --target /path/to/my-project --name "my-project" --profile STANDARD
```

## Language

The repository documentation (`README.md`, `llms.txt`, `SKILL.md`, `SECURITY.md`,
`RELEASE_GATE.md`) is English, with German `README_de.md`, Spanish `README_es.md`, French `README_fr.md`, Russian `README_ru.md`, Japanese `README_ja.md`, Simplified Chinese `README_zh.md`, Hindi `README_hi.md`, Arabic `README_ar.md`, Bengali `README_bn.md`, and Portuguese `README_pt.md` guides. The generated
artefacts are not: the template bodies under `template/` and the CLI output of
the tools in `template/_tools/` are currently German. File names, profile
markers and YAML front matter keys are language-neutral. There is no language
switch; an English template set is an open task in `TODO.md`.

## Disambiguation

This repository is a documentation scaffold for software, research, and
operations projects that are maintained with LLM agents. It is not a runtime
agent framework, not a task runner, and not a replacement for project-specific
source code or CI.
